diaspora_bullets: Atlanta's Indian community turned a school auditorium into a fundraiser of unusual scale
The money supports Mobile Eye Surgical Units in rural India
hook_line: ATLANTA CONCERT RAISES OVER $2 MILLION FOR EYE CARE IN INDIA

hook_stat.sub: Commitments surpassing $2 million at the year-end finale in Cumming, Georgia

news_summary: Sankara Nethralaya USA's year-end Music & Dance for Vision finale in Cumming, Georgia, drew more than 1,000 attendees on November 4, 2026, and brought in commitments surpassing $2 million.
payoff: The $2 million in commitments will fund Sankara Nethralaya's mobile surgical work in rural India.

stats.label: Dance and music academies from across metro Atlanta performed at the finale
Largest single commitment, from Mrs Shanta Lall in memory of her husband, Dr Shanker Lal
Years in Sankara Nethralaya USA's history — its largest academy turnout in that time
